settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace, publishing queue and bulk scheduling.
settings.name: Name
settings.timezoneHint: Every scheduled time you enter is interpreted in this timezone, and stays correct across daylight saving changes.
settings.requireApprovalHint: Contributors submit posts for review instead of scheduling them directly.
settings.queueSubtitle: Recurring times for "add to the next queue slot". Each new post takes the earliest free slot.
settings.utmHint: Appended to links in your posts so you can attribute traffic. Leave blank to post links untouched.
settings.shortenHint: Replaces links with short ones you control, so clicks can be counted.
settings.aiBrandVoiceHint: A sentence or two about how this client sounds. Fed to the model with every request.
settings.bulkColumns: Columns: message, link, scheduled_at, media_url. Leave scheduled_at empty to use the next free queue slot. Dates are read in {timezone}.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Everything the Facebook Graph API will give us for this page
analytics.noPages: No Facebook pages are connected yet.
analytics.syncFailed: Could not read analytics from Facebook.
analytics.noData: Nothing captured yet. Pull from Facebook to fill this in.
analytics.unavailableHint: Meta removes insights metrics between API versions. These were requested and refused, so they are listed rather than silently dropped.
analytics.footnote: Figures come from the Facebook Graph API for {name}. Snapshots are stored here because Graph serves only about two years of history.
analytics.byPostHint: One row per post per destination — the same post can perform very differently on two pages, and averaging that away hides the signal.
analytics.noPosts: No published posts in this range.
analytics.reactionsByTypeHint: Like, love, wow, haha, sorry and anger.
analytics.noBreakdown: Facebook returned no breakdown for this range.
analytics.audienceHint: Demographics are lifetime snapshots from Facebook, so they show the audience as it stands now. New and lost likes are counted over the selected range.
analytics.coverageHint: The catalogue is every metric Meta documents. This is how much of it this destination has actually been shown to serve — untested means never asked for, which is not the same as refused.
analytics.coverageKey: Darker is served by Facebook; lighter was asked for and refused. The remainder has not been tested yet.

engagement.commentsHint: Comments on posts published from here. Hiding or deleting one changes it on Facebook straight away.
engagement.confirmDelete: Delete this comment on Facebook? This cannot be undone.
engagement.videosHint: Video-level figures, which combine every post and crosspost of the same video.
engagement.reviewsHint: Star ratings and recommendations left on the page.
engagement.inboxHint: Recent page inbox threads. Reading these needs the messaging permission.
engagement.externalHint: Posts that reached the page without going through this app. Reports understate the page without them.
engagement.noExternal: No other posts found in this range.

instagram.none: No Instagram business account is linked to a connected page yet.
instagram.noInsights: Nothing captured yet. Pull from Instagram to fill this in.

ads.none: No ad account is connected. Finding them needs the ads read permission.
ads.hint: Spend next to organic reach, so a jump in reach can be told apart from a jump in budget.
ads.actionsHint: Every action type the campaigns produced, summed over the range.
ads.noCampaigns: No campaign data in this range.
ads.reachNote: Campaign reach shows the highest single day rather than a sum, because reach counts people and adding daily figures would count the same person twice.
